{{Quote|Enjoying your stay on Talus? I find it quite relaxing here. Of course I'm looking at it from a civilian's perspective now. Used to be my word was law in this sector and the fates of billions of sentient beings were held in my hand. But that was a long time ago, when I was young and idealistic. So idealistic in fact that I chose to ignore my enemies, thinking they couldn't possibly hurt someone in my position. But I won't ignore them now. Care to make some money helping a former Moff correct the mistakes of his past?|Jusani Zhord to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Jusani Zhord''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who operated out of a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Nashal]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jusani Zhord was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
